goal: Abstain without unique positive after-cost SafeEV and size approved actions within hard risk limits.
narrative: The decision contract validates probability models, subtracts spread, commission, slippage, and uncertainty, and returns NO_TRADE unless one healthy candidate has positive SafeEV. The risk contract sizes from stop-loss exposure, rounds down to broker volume steps, and blocks entries at immutable per-trade, daily, weekly, drawdown, and position ceilings.
expected_outcome: Invalid inputs, non-positive or ambiguous edge, weakened limits, and breached loss controls all fail closed without broker interaction.

behaviors: All explicit trading costs reduce expected value
NO_TRADE is mandatory without a unique positive SafeEV
Position size rounds down from stop risk
Configured limits cannot weaken hard ceilings
